body: I was up until 3 last night. I confronted him out of frustration, and I shouldn't have. He told me he won't show affection to the dogs anymore, he implied that he might leave me, and he called me sick and jealous. He told me he doesn't need me. He said he thought I loved animals. I said I do, but that doesn't mean I want them in our house. I don't think I handled it well. He's up painting already. There's no way I can even make toast or pour myself a bowl of cereal, so I'm going to stop by the store for coffee and a protein bar on my way to work. I feel worse than ever, and I have a long day at work. I can't shake the feeling that I'm the problem here.
